design: Same five leave-task/new-wording folds as H604. Fit dc from native normalized MLP11 input z on 32 other-task old-wording endpoints. Fixed mean, isotropic affine change, ridge, isotropic plus ridge residual, and common shift followed by RMS normalization. Same-task ridge/normalized-shift diagnostics fit eight old-wording endpoints, not task-held-out. No evaluation dc used for any predictive coefficients. All use actual e to execute T. Reused panel, adaptive not independent confirmation.
ridge_lambda_rule: .1 times mean diagonal of centered training Gram matrix; fixed before evaluation, no sweep
shift_fit: 500 Adam steps, lr .03, float64, training-only normalized-input MSE, initialized at mean dc. No evaluation early stopping.
scope: No task-label input for shared models. Native context can encode format/task; this does not disentangle them. Low-dimensional parameterizations do not identify semantic units. Each fold is a separate cross-validation model.
